title: Zanzibari Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stew infused with the unique flavors of Zanzibari spice. Serve with a side of crusty bread for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add nutty, tender, and Zanzibari spices to pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth to pot and stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
